opportunities.title: Postdoctoral Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers in the humanities or social sciences based at a UK university or research organisation; UK or EEA citizens; must be postdoctoral and not hold a permanent academic post.
opportunities.summary: Three‑year fellowships to enable early‑career researchers to undertake independent, publishable research and develop teaching experience.

opportunities.title: Talent Development Awards 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based postdoctoral or senior researchers with a long‑term appointment at a UK HEI or independent research organisation, working in the humanities or social sciences.
opportunities.summary: Funding up to £10,000 to support skill development, collaboration or dissemination for researchers in the humanities and social sciences.

opportunities.title: APEX Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established independent researchers with a permanent or fixed‑term position at a UK university or not‑for‑profit organisation; must lead interdisciplinary collaboration across the Academies' remit.
opportunities.summary: Seed funding (up to 24 months) for interdisciplinary projects that bridge humanities, social sciences, science, engineering and technology, aiming for societal impact.

opportunities.title: SHAPE Involve and Engage
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based researchers at any career stage in the humanities or social sciences; must partner with a GLAM or performing arts organisation; prior public‑engagement experience preferred.
opportunities.summary: Funding for innovative public‑engagement projects that connect humanities and social sciences research with audiences via museums, libraries, archives or performing arts venues.

opportunities.title: International Interdisciplinary Research Projects 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based principal investigators from the humanities or social sciences (post‑doctoral or above) with a long‑term UK appointment; must involve overseas co‑applicants and interdisciplinary collaboration.
opportunities.summary: Two‑year interdisciplinary projects (up to £300,000) linking UK researchers with international partners to study mobilities across people, materials, ideas and innovation.

opportunities.title: Global Innovation Fellowships: DGAP 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based early‑ or mid‑career researchers in the humanities or social sciences; must hold a UK university or research institute position; fellowship hosted at DGAP Berlin.
opportunities.summary: One‑year fellowships (up to £150,000) to develop skills and networks in policy, cultural and creative sectors, with placement at the German Council on Foreign Relations.

opportunities.title: Knowledge Frontiers Symposium 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers in the humanities or social sciences affiliated with UK or German research institutions.
opportunities.summary: Funding to attend a three‑day symposium in April 2027, with seed funding available for collaborative projects arising from the event.

opportunities.title: Additional Needs
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current British Academy award‑holders or applicants planning to apply for a British Academy award within the next six months; must be UK‑based.
opportunities.summary: Funding (up to £4,000) to support additional needs such as equipment, caring costs, or assistance to prepare applications for British Academy calls.
